title: Sportraxs — RMB | UTCT 2026, UTCT 100M provisional leaderboard
publisher: Sportraxs (official timing platform linked from RMB Ultra-trail Cape Town)
claims: At 11:19 SAST on 22 November 2026 the official Sportraxs UTCT 100M page still carried the heading 'Provisional standings' and listed 127 runners: 75 finished, 36 withdrawn and 16 still on course.
The provisional overall top three on the official UTCT 100M leaderboard were Aleksei Tolstenko in 21:32:48, Pieter de Wortelaer in 23:05:12 and Careth Arnold in 23:53:08.
Careth Arnold's 23:53:08 was the fastest women's time on the provisional leaderboard; Magdalena Kraszpulska was second in 25:11:23 and Kerry-Ann Marshall third in 25:36:36.
The 2026 UTCT 100M page was still provisional at 11:19 SAST, before the 45-hour cut-off at 14:00, so these places were not a final result.
